title: Paracargo Operations Safety

nodes.text: Mark the target area with a large X using visible flagging in an open or cleared area

evidence.source_text: Mark the target area with a large X using visible flagging in an open or cleared area.

nodes.text: Ensure the drop site is roughly an acre in size, suitable locations include helispots, ridge tops, and meadows

evidence.source_text: The drop site should be roughly an acre in size, depending on terrain and vegetation. Most helispots, ridge tops, and meadows work well.

nodes.text: Ensure camps are at least 600 from target area

evidence.source_text: Camps should be at least 600 from target area.

nodes.text: Clear all persons, vehicles, and animals from the drop site prior to arrival of the cargo aircraft

evidence.source_text: All persons, vehicles, and animals should be cleared from the drop site prior to arrival of the cargo aircraft.

nodes.text: Assign an individual in charge at the drop site

evidence.source_text: An individual should be in charge at the drop site.

nodes.text: Alert all personnel around the drop site that cargo operations are about to begin

evidence.source_text: The individual in charge should alert all personnel around the drop site that cargo operations are about to begin.

nodes.text: Relay information to cargo aircraft: confirm drop location, winds at ground level, specific hazards, and readiness to receive cargo

evidence.source_text: The individual in charge should relay the following information to the cargo aircraft: Confirm drop location. Winds at ground level. Any specific hazards in the area. Individuals on the ground are clear and ready to receive cargo.

nodes.text: Ensure all personnel are heads up in case a parachute doesnt open

evidence.source_text: All personnel in the vicinity should be heads up in the rare event that a parachute doesnt open.

nodes.text: Keep all personnel clear of the drop site until paracargo operations are complete

evidence.source_text: All personnel should remain clear of the drop site until paracargo operations are complete.

nodes.text: Treat cargo parachutes with care and return them to their respective bases at the earliest convenience

evidence.source_text: Treat cargo parachutes with care and return them to their respective bases at the earliest convenience.
